map.为什么医生说「长好了」但还不能负重？: Why does the doctor say it has healed but I still cannot bear weight?
map.骨折愈合分纤维愈合、临床愈合与骨性愈合三阶段。临床愈合（压痛消失、X 线连续骨痂: Fracture healing proceeds in three stages: fibrous healing, clinical healing and bony healing. At clinical healing (tenderness gone, continuous callus on X-ray) the cast can be removed and light activity started, but reaching the bony strength needed for full weight bearing usually takes several more weeks. Follow medical advice and advance gradually; bearing weight too early can cause deformation or refracture.
map.吃什么能加速骨折愈合？: What can I eat to speed up fracture healing?
map.愈合主要靠自身成骨与稳定固定，营养是基础而非「特效药」。保证充足蛋白质、钙、维生: Healing relies mainly on the body's own bone formation and stable fixation; nutrition is the foundation, not a 'miracle drug'. Ensure adequate protein, calcium, vitamin D and moderate sun exposure, and stop smoking (nicotine markedly inhibits bone formation). This table is a time reference only; actual practice should follow follow-up imaging, and weight bearing must not be started early on feel alone.
